title: Which art style do you like the best/looks the least ai generated?
author: somedonkusgames
selftext:
im trying to rework the cards for my baseball card rougelike game and am experimenting with different art styles. which art style do you like the best and would pass without looking like total slop? i got feedback on my last post that the cartoony style was a bit to ai looking. im finding it hard for GPT image to keep the pixel style consistent though. 

i basically have three ideas of how to change the art style: A. a high detail pixel art style, B. a more console looking style, or C. a retro 16 bit pixel style

the vibe i am going for in the game is an old school 90s baseball style game with retro graphics. 

also if you have any feedback on the card frames im all ears. the idea is that the power level number is in the top left corner, and the other info they have is a position and name.

comments.author: Etcetera-Umbrella
comments.body: If say I like a best

comments.author: GlobalCurry
comments.body: I'd have to see more context to know how they look against everything else int he game.

comments.author: Trojanheadcoach
comments.body: I like A the best and none of them necessarily come off as ai to me. I feel like it’s more about the consistency throughout the game tho that makes me see stuff as ai

comments.author: ndilday
comments.body: I like A best, and think B looks the most AI generated.

comments.author: 12redandblack12
comments.body: i like a honestly, trying to make an old school game is cool, but retro doesn't just mean conventional pixel art. i'm going for a more old school vibe with my project and got results i'm happy with using pixels as the medium, rather than a deliberate aesthetic.

comments.author: LL555LL
comments.body: If it isn't RBI baseball what's the point?... Mostly kidding

replies.author: Pandaman_323
replies.body: Hey if it was the OG RBI with a season/franchise mode I'd be in heaven.

replies.author: somedonkusgames
replies.body: I havent heard of this game until this post but ill have to look it up now!

comments.author: Pandaman_323
comments.body:
\#1 or #3.

Is your game going to be like the old RBI Baseballs? If so, I'd love to track your progress - I was asking Claude last night how to make the AI better for the old RBI NES games lol

replies.author: somedonkusgames
replies.body: Ill have to look this game up! Your the second person to mention it

comments.author: SyrysSylynys
comments.body: I feel like A is the most baseball-card-like, but the baseball bat looks a bit wonky in it--too short, and maybe even slightly curved? C might work better if the rest of the card had the same low resolution as the player; as it stands, it's like an 8-bit player inside a 16-bit frame.

replies.author: somedonkusgames
replies.body: Good point, the card and the art should have the same pixel size

comments.author: JDad67
comments.body: I’d expect a varied assortment like real life cards. Do you need a single pose?

comments.author: Brewgazer
comments.body: A but if I’m being honest stop wasting your time with roguelikes, steam has 1800+ roguelike demos out right now and the one with the highest player base has 9 people playing it. Do something unique it’s over saturated.
